To determine which option is **not** an accurate description of the efforts parties plan to make in order to achieve the long-term temperature goal under the **Paris Agreement**, we must carefully analyze the content of each option against the provisions of the Agreement.

---

### **Option A**:
> *Each Party shall prepare and communicate nationally determined contribution every five years and account for anthropogenic emissions and removals corresponding to their nationally determined contributions.*

This aligns directly with **Article 4, paragraph 2**, which requires each Party to prepare and communicate successive NDCs and to account for emissions in accordance with **Article 4, paragraph 13**, which outlines the details of how parties should report and account for emissions.  
**✅ This is an accurate description.**

---

### **Option B**:
> *All Parties shall provide the information necessary for clarity, transparency and understanding in accordance with decision 1/CP.21 and any relevant decisions of the Conference of the Parties to the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change.*

This is **inaccurate**. In the **Paris Agreement**, the relevant decisions are related to the **Conference of the Parties serving as the meeting of the Parties to this Agreement** (not the original Convention’s COP). Specifically, in **Article 4, paragraph 8**, parties are required to provide information "in accordance with decision 1/CP.21 and any relevant decisions of the Conference of the Parties serving as the meeting of the Parties to this Agreement". The phrase "Conference of the Parties to the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change" refers to the **original COP** under the Convention, not the **Paris Agreement's COP**. This misrepresents the scope of the governing body.  
**❌ This is **not** an accurate description.**

---

### **Option C**:
> *Developed countries should pursue domestic mitigation measures, take the lead by undertaking economy-wide absolute emission reduction targets and provide transparent and consistent information on support for developing country Parties.*

This corresponds to **Article 4, paragraphs 4 and 9**, which emphasize that developed countries must take the lead with economy-wide emission reduction targets (Paragraph 4) and continue to provide transparent and consistent information on support (Paragraph 9).  
**✅ This is an accurate description.**

---

### **Option D**:
> *Parties should strive to hold the increase in the global average temperature to well below 2 °C above pre-industrial levels and increase the ability to adapt to the adverse impacts of climate change.*

This is explicitly stated in **Article 2, paragraph 1**, which sets the **long-term temperature goal** and acknowledges the need to **increase adaptive capacity**.  
**✅ This is an accurate description.**

---

### **Conclusion**:

Only **Option B** incorrectly refers to the **original COP of the Convention** rather than the **COP serving as the meeting of the Parties to the Paris Agreement**, thereby misrepresenting the proper context and governance structure of the Paris Agreement.

$$

$$
